Episode 252. The War Begins (4)
As Liet's command was issued, the Golden Fleet increased its altitude.
Creak, crackle...!
Soon, the topsides of the ships in the Golden Fleet tilted left and right like the wings of a beetle, revealing the golems hidden within.
Elo2, the mass-produced version of Malieth Hister's golem, 'Elo Hister'.
Ziffle's biological golem, Kinzelo Plutonian, the Empire Mine.

All 'humanoid war machines' researched in the Human World to date had significant ethical issues because they used living humans or life as materials. Only Elo2 was a war machine born purely from magical engineering.
It was also the most powerful war machine.
The blue body representing Hister's record magic was as durable as ancient millennia-old iron, and its core, forged from a heart of light, contained immense power akin to a dragon's heart.
Even the artifacts equipped in Elo could perform simultaneous incantations, and their close combat abilities were on par with first rank guardian knights.
[Commencing battle.]
[Commencing battle.]
Flash!
The eyes of the Elo2s simultaneously emitted a blue light. Three hundred Elo2 units began to descend in unison.
Elo2 was not a weapon designed to confront transcendental beings like Bligiet or to combat the Origin Stone.

After completing their descent, the Elo2 units immediately set Ziffle's forces as their target. Protected by the blessing of Eternal Flames, the Plutonian Domination Sword, and the Crimson Sword, the Elo2s quickly engaged in battle with the lines of Ziffle mages.
[Eliminate Ziffle. You will be eliminated.]
Ziffle's mages were already struggling to create even minor variables against the Genesis.
With the addition of the Elo2 units, the mages couldn't afford to pay attention to the Genesis.
Furthermore, Bligiet couldn't restrain the Elo2s either. The Genesis didn't allow him any respite.
"What confidence you must have. You were cornered by just half a warrior from the Sun God Temple, and yet, what makes you so boldly appear?"
Clang!
Luna struck Bligiet's head with Krantel, saying,
‘When did she get so close?’
As a Sun God, Bligiet had always believed his insight could penetrate everything.
He thought he wouldn't miss or fail to encompass anything, no matter how complex the battle or how pressured he was by the Genesis.
However, he had already missed Luna's movement, the direction of the sword energy supporting her from Ban, and the location of Jin controlling Eternal Flames from the rear.

In such circumstances, it was impossible for him to attack the Elo2s. Naturally, the battlefield transformed into two main confrontations: between the Genesis and Bligiet, and between the Elo2 units and the mages.
"To think a piece of the being who created this world could be so laughable. You borrow the body of my ancestor and serve those who wish to destroy the world. Aren't you ashamed?"
[An underling, you say? That's one way to see it. Worry not, for this world will be reconstructed by my hands. Then, dangerous mortals like you won't appear.]
Bligiet's blade grazed Luna's forehead. Of course, Luna wasn't the least bit intimidated and swung Krantel even closer.
Frustration.

With each passing moment, Bligiet felt as if his limbs were becoming rigid, engulfed by an uncomfortable sensation. Despite emitting infinite sun energy throughout the battlefield, the Genesis' martial arts showed no signs of waning.

Not to mention Elo, even the fleet that had perfectly surrounded the Tower of Story couldn't be checked. For Bligiet, who considered himself near omnipotent, it was a series of incomprehensible events.
A sense of crisis was looming.
And Bligiette wasn't the only one feeling this crisis.
Kellic Ziffle, the leader of Ziffle watching the entire situation from the tower's main body, was also feeling anxious.
‘...The Origin Stone's calculations were wrong. Or rather, only partially calculated.’
Throughout the pursuit by the Divine Fleet, Ziffle had calculated and predicted numerous battle scenarios through the Origin Stone.

The Origin Stone had finished calculating that the Divine Fleet would momentarily halt the Tower of Story today, and the alliance would send reinforcements. Then, after a manageable battle, both sides would withdraw without significant losses.

However, "the current Origin Stone" had underestimated the vastness of the Barmel Alliance. It accurately predicted that six hundred ships would provide support, but it failed to foresee the synergistic effect between those ships and the Genesis.
The spectacle of the Tower of Story enveloped in flames and thunder was not predicted by any calculation.
‘If we can't retreat in time, the Origin Stone will be overloaded. To withdraw, we might have to pay a great price.’
Kelliark Ziffle gazed into the crystal orb, lost in thought. Giving up what must be given up and somehow preserving the Origin Stone intact while retreating was the best strategy.
He couldn't afford to think long. Ban and Luna's movements were captured in his crystal orb, but Jin was not visible. Both Ziffle and Bligiet had missed Jin.
‘Abandon Bligiet.’
KelliarK quickly reached a conclusion.
Abandoning him meant that Temar's body, his left arm, would fall into the grasp of the Barmel Alliance. It was as if a safety mechanism for "Malugia" had been removed.
It was a bad move, but there were no better options unless sudden support from the demon realm, from another dimension, came.

‘The demon realm won't send support. And even if we abandon Bligiet, he won't cease to exist. Given his absolute nature, he won't be able to surrender or join the Barmel Alliance, and since the constraints of Airan haven't been fully lifted yet, there's room for negotiation even if he harbors resentment later.’
Furthermore, by then, with the support of the demon realm, they might be able to further refine the Origin Stone, so the threat of Bligiet wouldn't be an issue in many ways.
"Retrieve all the powers of the Origin Stone supporting Bligiet. Retreat immediately once the retrieval is complete."
[Understood.]
Elona responded in a dry voice. She was fused at the bottom of the Origin Stone, which had taken the form of a tree, along with the sanctuary.
‘Kelliark, this fucker...!’
Bligiet immediately realized Kelliark's betrayal, but raging was all he could do. Now, with Luna and then Ban engaging in close combat, he couldn't afford such luxuries.
The two Genesis who had started the joint attack did not miss that something was wrong with Bligiet. They had recognized Kelliark's betrayal instantly.
They confirmed that the energy of the Origin Stone was rapidly weakening. Naturally, it meant that Ziffle was using Bligiet as bait to desperately escape.
[How does it feel to be used and discarded by a being you considered insignificant, Bligiet?]
[Shut up, Ban. After all, Kelliark and I were merely in a contractual relationship.]
[Emphasizing the contractual relationship so desperately, it seems you're quite shocked. Today, I'll be able to relieve the body of my long-time friend that's bound to you.]
The tide of battle had been tilting for a while, and Ziffle ultimately chose to retreat.
Then, it was the Barmel Alliance's turn to deliver the final blow.
[All superhumans, prepare to launch…]
As Liet was issuing the command throughout the fleet, she suddenly noticed blue letters appearing in front of the ship Sara.
It was a message formed by Valeria's record magic, indicating that the superhumans should not be deployed.
[No, everyone stands by. It's the order of the clan head.]
The reason why Valeria delivered Jin's command to Liet in this form, and why the Origin Stone and Bligiet had not been able to pinpoint Jin's location until now.
It was because Jin had been moving with Valeria from a certain point.

After joining up with Jin while hidden by Eternal Flames and the Plutonian Domination Sword, Valeria had since been "hiding" the records she created on the battlefield so that the Origin Stone and Bligiet couldn't read her directly.
Thanks to this, Jin had already passed Bligiet and reached the central part of the Tower of Story. Kelliark's crystal orb was still not showing that area.
Whoosh, whooooosh...!
Suddenly, the Eternal Flames engulfing the entire tower began to swirl.
It was gathering towards Bramante, Jin's sword. The flames, reaching ten miles, moved at an unbelievable speed.
"...Jin Runkandel!?"
At that moment, Kelliark flinched and turned the crystal orb. Jin, shown in the orb, was already swinging his sword towards him.
The target was the Origin Stone.
"Didn't I tell you, Kelliark? Today, I too wish to hear the Origin Stone's screams."
The vast and blue sword qi, rushing to split the tower's main body in one stroke, could not be stopped by Kelliark.
Even if it were Ban, an unexpected attack of this magnitude would have been difficult to avoid serious injury. Kelliark hurriedly spread a protective shield, but it was futile.
Kelliark wasn’t aware of the sword qi, condensed with Eternal Flames, tearing through the shield and could reach towards him.
Had Elona Ziffle not thrown herself in front of the Origin Stone at that moment, Kellic would have been bisected and instantly consumed by flames, turning into ashes.
Elona deflected Jin's sword qi in her human form, as if she was before being controlled by the holy crown.
The shockwave crumpled the bottom part of the Origin Stone, and at that moment, Jin could hear two voices simultaneously.
Hiiiiii...!
"Lord Jin...!"
It was the screams of the Origin Stone, even more intense than during the Sword Emperor's War, and the voice of Ellona.
